quotes.text: The new test_addrBookDataAdapter.js contains named testSanity and testCellText tasks. It checks all versus selected directories, sorting, mailing-list row properties, and vCard cell text as values are added, reordered, and removed. The cell-text task detaches its listener tree with setTree(null) after assertions. The filename ties the test to its class module and the tasks state the behavior. This is a local test naming and cleanup example.
